title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti according to package instructions until al dente.
While pasta cooks, fry pancetta in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove from heat.
In a bowl, whisk together eggs, egg yolk, cheeses, and plenty of black pepper.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/2 cup of cooking water.
Working quickly, add hot pasta to the skillet with pancetta. Toss to combine.
Remove from heat. Pour in egg mixture, stirring constantly. Add reserved pasta water a little at a time until creamy.
Serve immediately with extra cheese and black pepper.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and salt for at least 1 hour.
Grill or pan-sear chicken until cooked through. Set aside.
In a large pot, heat oil. Sauté onion until soft. Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute.
Add canned tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Return chicken to the pot. Stir in cream and garam masala.
Simmer 10 minutes. Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.

title: Avocado Toast
summary: Simple, healthy, and trendy — smashed avocado on sourdough with a sprinkle of chili flakes.
instructions: Toast sourdough until golden and crisp.
Scoop avocado into a bowl. Mash with lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Spread avocado mixture evenly on toast.
Sprinkle with chili flakes and optional toppings.
